subject: Digital Organism architecture
content: The 3DVR Digital Organism separates user-owned memory from reasoning model weights.

subject: Digital Organism v0.1
content: The v0.1 milestone is named Remember Me.

subject: Digital Organism storage
content: The seed memory layer is local-first and uses Python, SQLite, and JSONL without third-party dependencies.

subject: Digital Organism providers
content: Reasoning providers are replaceable; the same memory context can be used with local Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

subject: Private conversation history
content: Real conversation exports belong under data/private and must not be committed to the public repository.
